description: This file defines a static class 'CanNotGenerateImplicitFieldIdsDiagnostic' that contains diagnostic information and methods related to errors encountered during code generation, specifically when implicit field identifiers cannot be generated. It includes constant definitions for diagnostic IDs, titles, message formats, and a method to create diagnostic instances using the Roslyn API.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating an error when implicit field identifiers cannot be generated for a given symbol, using details like symbol location and display string.
